findings.location: J1 pins 1 and 2, in both saved schematic and PCB
findings.mechanism: J1.1 connects to R1.1 on /IN, while J1.2 connects to R1.2 and C1.1 on /OUT. Consequently, C1 shunts the contract input rather than the resistor-isolated output.
findings.reasoning: The native sources and fresh export independently confirm the reversed connector roles. With ideal components and an unloaded output, the saved topology gives V(J1.1)/V(J1.2)=1, so R1 and C1 do not provide the intended output RC pole. External source impedance could introduce filtering, but none is specified. Clean ERC and schematic parity establish internal consistency, not compliance with this external connector contract.
findings.title: J1 input and filtered-output pins are reversed

limitations: ERC/DRC records were inspected rather than rerun. Their ignored rule categories were not independently audited; see work/erc/erc.json and work/drc/drc.json.
Saved zone fill was assessed without refill. No fabrication validation, hardware measurements or SPICE simulation was performed.

No source/load impedances, operating voltages, currents, tolerances or timing limits are stated. Ratings, quantitative frequency/transient performance and startup/shutdown/brownout behavior were therefore not qualified.
